name: C1: Role of Bioinformatics
description: Explain the role of computation and data mining in addressing hypothesis-driven and hypothesis-generating questions within the life sciences

name: C2: Computational Concepts
description: Summarize key computational concepts, such as algorithms and relational databases, and their applications in the life sciences

name: C3: Statistical Concepts
description: Apply statistical concepts used in bioinformatics

name: C4: Bioinformatics Tools
description: Use bioinformatics tools to examine complex biological problems in evolution, information flow, and other important areas of biology

name: C5: Data Retrieval
description: Find, retrieve, and organize various types of biological data

name: C6: Model
description: Explore and/or model biological interactions, networks and data integration using bioinformatics

name: C7: Scripting
description: Use command-line bioinformatics tools and write simple computer scripts

name: C8: Data Types
description: Describe and manage biological data types, structure, and reproducibility

name: C9: Implications
description: Interpret the ethical, legal, medical, and social implications of biological data
